overview_description.description:
Whirl's proprietary payment terminal allows customers to pay with a fingerprint in just 1 second. It is the fastest and most secure method of payment on the market, offering the security of a chip card with a nearly invisible payment experience.

Just a single press to the payment terminal, and payment is complete.
